dedupeText: mid century soul album cover layout 1960s soul funk grid layout dripping type primary colors action photography horizontal banding separating typography from imagery contrast between illustrated cold title and warm flame subtitle repetitive grid of small action shots balanced by one large focal portrait vibrant primary color blocks against a deep black field combine a black typographic field with a multi cell photo grid at the base using a mix of illustrated novelty type and condensed gothic fonts to evoke mid century soul music packaging

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, multi-layered 1960s album cover featuring a black background, a top row of colored rectangular headers, illustrated 'dripping' title text, a grid of performance photos, and a large central artist name in a condensed sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal banding separating typography from imagery
Contrast between illustrated 'cold' title and warm 'flame' subtitle
Repetitive grid of small action shots balanced by one large focal portrait
Vibrant primary color blocks against a deep black field
coreInvariants: Black background for the central typographic section
A 2x4 grid of small vertical photos on the bottom left
A single larger vertical photo on the bottom right
A yellow horizontal band containing track listings

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography dominates the top two-thirds; photography occupies the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, condensed sans-serif artist name in the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down scanning from the colorful headers to the dripping title, then to the artist name, ending on the photo grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the layout is packed with information and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background providing high contrast for white and yellow text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Yellow band and white display type for readability.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Green, purple, red, and blue blocks in the top header; orange and green floral icons.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primary colors against a low-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Main title features vertical icicle-like drips hanging from the bottom of each glyph
Artist name uses a clean, extra-condensed gothic skeleton
Subtitles use a wide, outlined sans-serif with an inner glow or gradient
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title letters have irregular, organic 'melting' textures on the vertical strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of textured/illustrated display type with clean, utilitarian condensed sans-serifs.
graphicDevices: Dotted/floral circular icons in a grid

preserve: Dripping effect on the main title
Condensed nature of the artist name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy feel of the artist name.
The main title requires a specific 60s novelty texture not found in standard fonts.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a layout with a black top half and a photo grid bottom half. The bottom left has an 8-cell grid of small vertical performance photos; the bottom right has one large vertical portrait. Include a yellow horizontal stripe across the middle and four colored blocks (green, purple, red, blue) at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main title in a white dripping 'icicle' style at the top. Add a large condensed sans-serif name in the center. Add a secondary wide, outlined sans-serif below it. Place small track names in the yellow band.

verificationChecks: Is the 'dripping' effect present on the top title?
Is there a clear 2x4 grid of images on the bottom left?
Are the four color blocks present at the top edge?
Is the central name in a condensed, flat-stroke font?

adjustableVariables: Color of the top header blocks
Number of photos in the bottom grid
Intensity of the dripping effect on the title
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles
Record label logos and catalog numbers

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn quality in the novelty title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the dripping effect looks like ice/sweat, not blood.
Check that the yellow band is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the grid of photos is aligned with thin white gutters.
Confirm the top color blocks are distinct and saturated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a black typographic field with a multi-cell photo grid at the base, using a mix of illustrated novelty type and condensed gothic fonts to evoke mid-century soul music packaging.
